They slept on the Congo-slippery rafts holding up the city, and would, for a ha'penny, dart after parasols or kites--that is, if the kites happened to be made of hard glazy "B'bados kite papah"--lost on the rolling bronze sea.

As long as I've got breath in my body--as long as I is got my boy child to shield from de worle--from de filth and disease of this rotten, depraved place--as long as I got my fo' gal chirrun in B'bados in somebody else han'--um can't be a old story!"
